scope: Sustainable agriculture technical assistance and local food-system education

records.name: NCAT ATTRA Sustainable Agriculture
records.description: National sustainable-agriculture technical assistance program offering direct access to agriculture specialists, publications, videos, podcasts, short courses, events, funding leads, and practical guidance for farmers, ranchers, land managers, and educators.
access_steps: Browse ATTRA topics or search the resource library.
Use Ask an Ag Expert by phone or online for individualized guidance.
Verify dates, eligibility, and geography for funding opportunities and events before acting.
records.availability_notes: ATTRA provides information and technical assistance, not guaranteed funding or legal, tax, or individualized financial advice. Funding opportunities, events, courses, and featured materials change frequently. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: The Full Circle of Local Food Systems
records.description: NCAT educational article explaining local food systems as interconnected networks across five sectors: production, processing, distribution, consumption, and waste management or food recovery.
records.availability_notes: Published June 16, 2025. This is an educational framework and not a direct assistance program. It is useful for explaining food-system roles, relationships, gaps, and sequencing. Verified August 6, 2026.
